integrity: A standalone exact-rational normal-tail/Jensen certificate and complete analytic uniqueness proof accompany the claim; numerical roots are diagnostic and independently unaudited.
scientific_limitations: The two ecological phase switches concern an exact noise average inserted into a pure-defector mean-field growth proxy; they do not establish survival/extinction of the stochastic spatial lattice. The pre-clipping mean is fixed but the post-clipping environmental mean changes with noise intensity. Unbounded Gaussian positive tails and the hard quality floor are essential.
title: Unique mortality peak and reentrant mean-field viability under clipped Gaussian habitat noise
